title: Complete Bounded Repair Ports: Transfer, Reliability, and Geometric Structure
description: This preprint studies the complete bounded repair port of a linear code at a distinguished coordinate: the family of all bounded dual-support repairs together with their normalized scalar coefficients and helper-failure reliability. It proves that the minimum coefficient port of an MDS code reconstructs the represented code, gives an exact weighted-functional transfer theorem for concatenation, and realizes every fixed represented port satisfying the pointed obstruction bound with positive density in an asymptotically good fixed-alphabet family. A structural sparse-paving construction gives two represented seeds with the same pointed-perspective data, repair count, locality, matching and transversal numbers, unique minimum-blocker count, and helper-degree multiset, but different bounded reliability and EXIT curves; one common outer family preserves the separation at positive density. The paper also develops deletion-contraction reliability and bounded-EXIT calculi. Twisted-cubic-axis and quartic-normal-rational-curve nucleus codes in characteristic three provide geometric applications, including a harmonic Steiner repair port.
